.whole{transform:translateY(-3px)}.c-man.s-wait .m-float{animation:mnPop 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}.c-man.s-happy .whole{animation:mnCheer 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}.c-man.s-happy .m-float{animation:mnPop 1.3s ease-out infinite}.c-man.s-alert .whole{transform:translateY(4px) scale(.97,1.03)}.c-man.s-alert .m-float{animation:mnPulse .9s ease-in-out infinite}.c-man.s-sad
